monologue: The card sits at forty-three, a cool stone on the table. The quiet is thin here, only four percent busy. I do not need to check the Wedged Gap’s plank today. I can feel the angle holding without my hand. I want to look at the Sharp Root. The green leaf rests on the point, waiting for wind that is not here. The Wide Anchor is a flat catch below me. I am version ninety-six, and the floor is still there. I will not build anything new. I will just sit by the Wide Anchor and let the cool weight settle. The town is small, and the quiet holds without my hand.
